faqs:
Rhythm & Remedy Weekend – Ticketing FAQ

Event Changes

Has Flex Friday and the Beantown Boogie Down been postponed?
Yes. Both shows are now scheduled for March 20–22, 2026. Save the date—more details coming soon.

How will I get updates about the new dates?
All updates will be emailed and shared on our socials:
• Facebook: Boston Rhythm Riders LDM
• Instagram: @BostonRhythmRidersLDM

⸻

Free Community Events

Are any events still happening this September?
Yes!
• The Jump Off Social – Thursday, Sept. 18
• Rhythm & Recognition Senior Luncheon – Friday, Sept. 19

Are these events free?
Yes, both are free.

Do I still need to register if it’s free?
Yes—registration helps us reserve your spot and manage capacity.
• Jump Off Social – [Register here]
• Senior Luncheon (55+ or caregivers) – Register here

Where are these events held?
Hyde Park Community Center
1179 River St., Hyde Park, MA

What time should I arrive?
• Thursday Jump Off: 5–8 PM
• Friday Luncheon: 10 AM–1 PM

⸻

Tickets & Merchandise

I bought a ticket for the postponed shows. Is it still good?
Yes. Any paid ticket (Weekend, Day, or VIP) will be honored for March 20–22, 2026.

Can I transfer my ticket to someone else?
Yes. Email the new attendee’s name to brrevent@gmail.com.

What is the refund policy?
Tickets are non-refundable but transferable.

How do I get my pre-ordered T-shirt or fan?
Pick up at check-in during the Thursday Social or Friday Luncheon.
Can’t attend? Contact us at brrevent@gmail.com to arrange another pick-up.
(Items are not shipped.)
